dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD - Settlement Names v9.0 dataset consists of settlement points with name and attributes for all 26 provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (COD). The current version supersedes the GRID3 COD - Settlement Names v8.0 . The following changes were made: The data for Haut-Katanga, Haut-Lomami, Ituri, Kwango, Lomami, Maniema, and Tanganyika provinces were updated. Dataset citation: Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Settlement Names v9.0. New York: Columbia University. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/grid3-cod-settlement-names-v9-0. Accessed [DAY MONTH YEAR]. Contacts and data queries: The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu
